# Checkbox Group

Select any combination of independent options in one labeled group.

## Examples

### Release channels

Choose one or more independent release channels.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move focus into and out of the group. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggle the focused checkbox item. |

## Accessibility

The labeled group preserves each item as an independently focusable checkbox with checked and disabled state.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/) for the host accessibility contract.
